text:
| check | status | failure class | detail |
|---|---|---|---|
| image-pinned | passed |  | rfl-ns3:m6 in ns3sim1 is sha256:da7a3245b1b91dd472d1ddb9497b3bd1abb3efdbaee38c45fe790dff565a61c6, the ns3.image pin |
| container-locked-down | passed |  | ns3sim1 is a kvm guest on kernel 6.8.0-147-generic; both containers ran the locked image as 10001:10001 with no network, no device, no capabilities, no-new-privileges, a read-only root, AppArmor docker-default and one writable mount /run/rfl/out; the entry point reported uid and gid 10001 |
| config-applied | passed |  | all 60 cases hold their declared rates, delays, MTU, buffer, ECN thresholds and pmax, seed, the profile's QbbEnabled, EcnEnabled and CcMode, and the ten DCQCN attributes, read back from the model objects; profiles c-both, c-ecn, c-none, c-pfc |
| same-traffic | passed |  | in each of 3 fan-in groups every case's network file has the same topology, links, flows, buffer, thresholds and DCQCN lines as the first; only pfc, ecn, cc_mode and seed differ, as each profile defines |
| flows-accounted | passed |  | 700 flows in 60 cases are all in flows.tsv; 700 completed with every byte in order and 0 did not finish (none); in every case the switch's refusals counted from MacRx minus QbbEnqueue equal the MMU's drop lines |
| fct-bounds | passed |  | all 700 completed flows took at least 8 x payload / bottleneck + propagation (the closest at 1.140 x its bound), and every case took at least as long as the receiver link needs for the completed payload |
| pfc-as-configured | passed |  | in the 30 PFC-on cases the host pause handler ran once for every PAUSE and RESUME received and the switch refused no packet; 10 of them paused. In the 30 PFC-off cases the handler never ran, although the switch still sent PAUSE and hosts received it in 10 cases |
| ecn-as-configured | passed |  | in the 30 ECN-off cases the switch marked nothing, no CNP flag came back and no rate changed; in the 30 ECN-on cases every mark fell above kmin, every dequeue above kmax was marked, and 20 cases showed marks, CNP-flagged ACKs and DCQCN rate cuts |
| profiles-differ | passed |  | 10 pairs differing in PFC and 20 pairs differing in ECN and DCQCN saw their trigger and each gave different flow results and counters; 30 pairs saw no trigger and may match (n2-s1 c-ecn/c-both, n2-s1 c-none/c-pfc, n2-s1 c-none/c-ecn, n2-s1 c-pfc/c-both, n2-s2 c-ecn/c-both, n2-s2 c-none/c-pfc, ...) |
| rerun-identical | passed |  | run2 repeated all 60 cases with every seed and gave the same 840 modeled figure files |
| no-container-left | passed |  | guest.sh stop removed the containers of 20261116T151213Z-c-05-incast-mixed; no Track C container remains |
| host-untouched | passed |  | no simulator process and no Track C container on the host at the start and the end of the run |
